niche: a regional motor insurer's 2025 private-car claim frequency by sales region for a 2027 telematics pilot, the injury claims that claims-management firms notify months and years after the accident still to come
analyst_test: A strong analyst who builds each region's 2025 earned car-years from the policy records and completes its 2025 claims still to be reported with the region's own report-lag pattern from the closed accident years, or with bodily injury and damage developed separately, names Metro, because both completions carry the old notifying mix into a year when Valley's injury claims came through claims-management firms three times as often.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is each region's ultimate claim count for accident year 2025, the claims reported and those still to be notified, per earned car-year, which the field develops from reported counts with report-lag factors on segments whose lags are stable; here the lag is carried by the notifying channel (a claims-management firm notifies an injury claim months or years after the accident, inside the three-year limitation period), so swapping in another field's nouns loses the channel, the limitation that bounds the lag and the claims-farming wave that moved one region's mix.
layer1: a claims-system migration with legacy and new claim references
notification and accident dates in two formats across the migration
mid-term cancellations, adjustments and renewals in the policy records for earned exposure
windscreen-only claims kept in a separate cover file
postcode districts moved between sales regions in 2024
driver: The decisive quantity is the eventual count of events from a closed period, completed from those reported so far with lag factors taken per reporting channel, because one channel reports far later than the others and one unit's mix shifted toward it; completing each unit with its own past lag pattern, or with the standard split by event kind, under-counts that unit, and only the channel split reproduces earlier closed periods.
driver_concrete: Each region's 2025 claim frequency counts the claims still to be notified, completed with report-lag factors by notifying channel, because claims-management firms notify injury claims months and years late and Valley's 2025 claims came through them three times as often as before; Valley's own past lags and the bodily-injury split both leave it below Metro, and only the channel split reproduces 2021 and 2022 as they finally came in.
stump: The default path completes each region's 2025 claims still to be notified with the region's own report-lag pattern from the closed years, or develops bodily injury and damage separately, and names Metro, because claims-management firms notify injury claims months and years after the accident and Valley's 2025 injury claims came through them three times as often as before; completed by notifying channel, the split that reproduces 2021 and 2022 as they finally came in, Valley's 2025 frequency is the highest.

differentiation.task194: task194 v3 developed recent counts for a coding lag at all, measured from two vintages of one series; here every route develops the 2025 counts, and the decisive step is the reporting channel the lag lives in, whose mix shifted in one region, chosen by reproducing closed years
differentiation.task127: task127 v3 projected a bodily-injury paid reserve by restating its development at the latest settlement shares and was sent back because the reserving basis left the method open; here claim counts are developed for notification lag, the segment the lag lives in (the notifying channel) is chosen by reproducing closed accident years, and every reasonable channel development agrees
differentiation.task145: task145 re-converted only the own-denomination holders at the forward factors, each group's mix of holders estimated from the units seen in both periods; here a closed year's claims still to be notified are developed by notifying channel, whose lag holds within the channel while one region's channel mix moved
differentiation.task160: task160 timed a recurring wave by each group's lag behind the group it spreads from; here a closed year's late notifications are developed by the channel that carries the lag
differentiation.task138: task138 v1 rebuilt each unit's store at the forecast date from its replenishment record; here claim counts are developed for notification lag by the notifying channel
differentiation.task446: task446 v2 backed a base rate out of a screen's flag share through error rates that carry across years; here the quantity that carries across years is each notifying channel's report-lag pattern, and one region's channel mix moved

lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is how many people are at each small area on a typical day, known completely only as the members attached to each area and observed day by day only in a broad sample whose on-site rate falls with how far a member lives from the area; carrying the sample's rate for each kind of member onto the complete attachments credits the areas that draw their members from far away with too many present, so the rate has to be carried within the groups it varies across.
lineage.architecture: v1 (a quick-commerce grocer's 2027 weekday dark-store pilot among six metros, by each core's delivery-weighted density of people present, the commuting table's flows carried at a national survey's days on the premises)
lineage.fate: spent 2026-10-18 at stage 4: the isolated reader carried the survey's share by industry group and HOMEREL onto every flow by reflex and committed the golden call, Tessavon at 28,805 against Corrisford's 21,709 (score_reader.py exit 1); the stratum was a classifier both sources share, so the careful analyst's first group-by; the judge found the call forced, Gate H passing, and two ask forks

lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is how far each area's stock has fallen, observable either through the records of collectors who choose where to sample by how much they find there or through a fixed probability sample of the whole area; as a stock shrinks it retreats into the best part of its area and the collectors follow it, so their catch per unit of effort holds up while the stock falls and the parts they abandon drop out of their record, and only the fixed sample, weighted over the whole area, shows the fall.
lineage.architecture: v2 (re-rooted 2026-10-18 after architecture 1's stage-4 reader landed the call)
lineage.fate: spent 2026-10-18 at stage 4: the isolated reader went to the autumn survey first and weighted each depth band by its share of the stock area from plan 4.2's estimand and the manual's equal stations per band, committing Halmorie Deep at 63 per cent against Brettach Bank's 52 with every fall (score_reader.py exit 1); a survey whose own manual describes its strata under an estimand filed as a total over an area makes the design-based estimate the careful analyst's default; the judge found the call forced, DETERMINISTIC and APPROVE

lineage.architecture: v3 (registry heart failure survival, the patients lost to a move north carried from their NYHA class at the move)
lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is the share of units still free of an event a fixed time after their start, from a record that loses sight of units once they leave its reach, where units leave far more often after their recorded state has worsened; treating each loss as ordinary censoring credits the departed with the survival of the units still followed, so each departed unit's survival has to be carried from the state it was in when lost, through the moves between states and the state-specific event rates the followed units show.
lineage.fate: spent 2026-10-28: the portal's determinism round failed it with both judges (charter 3.2 read as the deaths on file), and the re-judge after the WHAT repair sent it back: plain Kaplan-Meier a rule-compliant reading naming Fennick (Gate C), the mechanic classed single_conceptual_flip (Gate G); two corrections of one graded quantity
